body:
TASK_AMENDMENT/v1 — added resources, authorization scopes, archive duty

This amendment extends Issue #440. Preserve all earlier boundaries. It does not authorize contacting Muse or connecting to any host.

## New reported context (not independently verified)

- Pasha reports two new Tailscale participants:
  - `Onion`, current display nickname `DISPLAY-07`, described as having 8G and “GPU Super” plus disks. Treat device identity, hardware, ownership, OS, and capacities as unverified until checked through authorized inventory.
  - `Muse from META`, a trusted prospective colleague. Trust does not imply identity verification or access. Credentials/private keys remain outside Muse's view and are never requested.
- Pasha reports a two-week schedule disruption after a statistical error in the tokenized-fuel (“myst oil”) estimate for the Codex idea generator. Treat the causal account and exact loss as reported until reconciled against available records.
- Pasha reports that Google free capacity expires weekly. Verify exact provider/quota cadence and the observed incident from dated authoritative evidence; do not assume or handle credentials.

## Add required work and artifacts

Add an **Archive & Information Conservation** position, plus a separate **Inference Treasury / Quota Reliability** position if the available agent registry justifies the coordination cost. These roles may be staffed by existing verified agents or explicitly marked UNSTAFFED; do not invent agents.

Publish these additional deliverables:

1. `VISIT_ARCHIVE_PROTOCOL/v1`: locate and cite the exact applicable version of the Indra Proposal / Infinite Archive of the Solar System rules from an authorized source. Bind claims to file/version/hash. If the text is not discoverable, mark the exact rule as BLOCKED and propose a clearly labelled provisional schema; do not claim compliance with an unseen specification.
2. `SSH_VISIT_RECEIPT/v1` and a retention design preserving, for every attempted and completed visit: immutable authorization/warrant ID and digest; approving principal; verified source and destination identities (Tailscale user or service identity plus stable node ID, not display nickname alone); exact purpose, target and capabilities; policy version; start/end timestamps; commands and requested subsystems; stdout/stderr or equivalent session recording where enabled; exit/result; transfer metadata; revocation/expiry; and hashes linking each item to its evidence. Include denied attempts and failures. Define append-only storage, independent integrity/fixity checks, replication across failure domains, restore/retrieval tests, provenance, retention/version migration, and loss detection. Never store private keys or bearer tokens. If secret material accidentally appears in captured output, preserve the original only in an owner-controlled encrypted evidence vault with incident handling, while keeping the ordinary index redacted; do not silently discard or overwrite it.
3. `ARCHIVE_COVERAGE_AND_GAPS/v1`: prove which layers actually record Tailscale control changes, network connections, SSH commands/session contents, host-side actions, and artifacts; state product-plan/configuration requirements and blind spots. Tailscale logs alone must not be represented as a complete immutable archive.
4. `ONION_AUTHORIZATION_AND_WORK_PLAN/v1`: treat `DISPLAY-07` as a mutable display name, not an authentication factor. Verify who/what controls the node and its machine identity before granting anything. Until then, no archive, user, secret, or production access. Prepare useful isolated synthetic work: a reproducible inference benchmark against approved non-sensitive test data; synthetic archive chunk/hash/fixity/restore tests; and a capacity report with measured hardware/model/runtime, quality, latency, power/cost if safely available. Assign concurrency/resource quotas and a WIP limit; no speculative GPU/VRAM claim. Any live workload or data access requires separate owner approval after verification.
5. `MUSE_AUTHORIZATION_AND_WORK_PLAN/v1`: Muse's first mandate is external media strategy / #cherkashin content research through a sanitized contract and reviewable, attributable deliverables. No Tailscale membership requirement, SSH, host inventory, internal repository access, archive access, credentials, keys, operational control, or authority to delegate. Consider later capabilities only as separate expiring, task-bound warrants after identity verification and independent review.
6. `MYST_OIL_AND_QUOTA_POSTMORTEM/v1`: reconcile the estimate, assumptions, forecast error, actual consumption, two-week schedule impact, and the specific missing reserve/guard that allowed it. Verify weekly Google quota expiry/refresh using official, dated evidence. Recommend a robust allocation: per-run and per-week caps, uncertainty margin, early warning, stop threshold, reserve, and explicit model/quota provenance. Do not touch or reveal Google credentials or enable paid spending.

## Authorization policy to recommend

Use a separate principal and narrow resource scope per agent/task, deny by default, just-in-time expiry, human-approved expansion, revocation test, and independent audit. Prefer current Tailscale Grants for new policy design, but inspect the existing policy before proposing a diff. A network grant for TCP/22 is only reachability; it does not constrain shell commands or prove read-only access. Keep host authorization (non-root account plus fixed allowlisted/forced command or equivalent) separate. Use device tags only for non-human service nodes; keep user-owned devices under their user identity. Do not assign tags, edit ACLs/grants, join/share nodes, issue auth keys, or touch SSH configuration in this task.

## Workload / “full happiness” requirement

Do not create continuous busywork or run agents at saturation. Keep narrow positions dormant when there is no evidence-backed task; wake them by semantic need; publish a fair assignment ledger showing workload, dependencies, queue, budgets, checkpoint, blocker, and next safe action. The safe synthetic work above gives Onion useful work while Minutta remains unavailable; Muse gets a clear, valuable media mandate without infrastructure privileges. Measure delivered evidence/value per inference cost and protect reserve so the previous myst-oil error cannot silently erase the schedule again.

## Additional hard gates

- No Minutta power-on, connection, CMOS action, recovery, or hardware handling pending physical human clearance.
- No external Muse transmission, tailnet/policy mutation, service activation, key/token use, or resource spending under this issue.
- Keep all visit authorization, enforcement, and evidence tied together: warrant -> verified identity -> exact scope -> recorded effect -> archived integrity proof -> expiry/revocation. Report any layer that cannot currently meet the Indra rule as a blocker, not a green status.
- Continue to separate reported information, verified facts, provisional design, and authorized operations in the final report.
